20261122-physics-e2-1.steps.0.hints.0: Ti son ti gue na yanga-ti-mbilimbili e, ye ti transmission tongana yaka ayeke kota.
20261122-physics-e2-1.steps.0.hints.1: Na yâ ti vide ayeke na molécule ti gaz oko pëpe.
20261122-physics-e2-1.steps.0.options.0.text: Ngbele so yaka (milieu) so alingbi ti mû son ayeke pëpe
20261122-physics-e2-1.steps.0.options.1.text: Ngbele so na yâ ti vide son ayeke ga lumière
20261122-physics-e2-1.steps.0.options.2.text: Ngbele so mur ti verre agbu son kue
20261122-physics-e2-1.steps.0.options.3.text: Ngbele so vibration ti horloge asi vite mingi
